# Python Iteration Tools

*Source:* [Python Iteration Tools](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ) · 12:34 · Prof X

## Iteration tools

### enumerate() · [00:42](https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ?t=42)

Yields (index, item) pairs.
The index starts at zero.

**On the board:**

```text
enumerate(iterable, start=0)
```

```
for i, name in enumerate(names):
    print(i, name)
```

### zip() · [06:40](https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ?t=400)

About zip().

```python
for a, b in zip(xs, ys):
    print(a, b)
```

**Examples:**

- zip([1, 2], 'ab') gives (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')
